tasks.title: Calibrating vbat_scale
tasks.statement: A multimeter on the battery connector shows **{vm} V**, the OSD — **{vo} V**, the current `vbat_scale` = **{s}**. Find the new value of `vbat_scale` (to an integer).
tasks.solution: In INAV the voltage is proportional to `vbat_scale` (battery.c), so new = old × V_multimeter / V_OSD. The OSD reads low — scale goes up.

tasks.title: Calibrating current_meter_scale from mAh
tasks.statement: After the flight the OSD shows **{mf} mAh**, the charger put in **{mc} mAh**, the current `current_meter_scale` = **{s}**. Find the new value (to an integer).
tasks.solution: The current in INAV = microvolts / scale, that is, inversely proportional to scale. The Battery.md formula: new = old × mAh_FC / mAh_charger. The flight controller undercounted — scale decreases.

tasks.title: Elevon throw in millimeters
tasks.statement: The elevon chord is **{c} mm**, the required throw is **{d}°**. By how many millimeters must the trailing edge of the elevon move from neutral?
tasks.solution: The trailing edge moves along an arc of radius c, and its displacement along the normal is h = c·sin δ. Measure with a ruler from neutral, with the servos limited by `min`/`max`.

tasks.title: Bank angle in a loiter circle
tasks.statement: A wing loiters over home at **{v} m/s** on a radius of **{r} m**. What bank is needed for a coordinated turn (degrees, g = 9.81)?
tasks.solution: tan φ = V²/(g·R). If φ is greater than `nav_fw_bank_angle` (35° by default), the wing cannot hold the radius `nav_fw_loiter_radius` and flies a wider circle.
